prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in after adoption selection or photo upload was helpful (+3.3% to +5.5%), but placing it after the adoption certificate caused a severe drop (-22.4%).
Specific layout redesigns (Stage, Scroll, Grid, Checklist), select new screens (Visibility Check, Interactive Welcome, Sound Calibration), desktop background notification prompts, and target hints (Path Selection, Sign-In Clarification, Multi-Account Preservation) were helpful.
Copy updates, incentives, sound cues, notification banners/toggles, and waiting screen info displays showed no clear effect.
Certain layout redesigns (Split Screen, Spotlight, Compact, Choose Path Stage Layout) degraded performance, while several new screens (Placement Guide, Troubleshooter, Pet Preview, Bio Preview) showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high for non-winning changes, projecting gains up to +12.0% on tests that showed no clear effect or caused drops.
Predictions were often too low for winning changes, predicting negative or modest impact (-15.0% to +3.7%) on changes that ultimately won (+3.3% to +14.0%).

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Upload Photos Screen Grid Layout Redesign: Redesign the photo upload screen using a grid layout to make upload slots and photo previews visually distinct. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 73.1% with custom pet creation having failure reports from support.)
1: [adoption, new_screen] New Companion Naming Screen: Add a dedicated companion naming screen before adoption certificate generation to allow explicit name entry. (why: Users spend over 1000 seconds in the adoption phase, so dedicated naming streamlines the certificate creation.)
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Screen Carousel Layout Redesign: Redesign the Pick Friend selection screen into a horizontal carousel layout for focused viewing. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off (73.1% conversion) and long completion times.)
3: [choose_path, new_screen] New Companion Overview Welcome Screen: Add a welcome overview screen before the story step introducing what desktop pets can do. (why: Mean completion time across onboarding is high and users write support tickets about desktop pet confusion.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Preservation Sync Hint: Display a explicit hint on the sign-in screen explaining that logging in preserves existing desktop pets. (why: 8 support emails mentioned pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
5: [home, notification] Waiting Screen Completion Audio Cue: Add an active sound component on the waiting screen to alert users when companion generation finishes. (why: Users spend a median of 201s and mean of 2336s waiting, often switching focus away from the desktop.)
6: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Centered Layout Redesign: Rebuild the home intro screen using a focused centered layout emphasizing desktop launch steps. (why: 3 support messages cited pet not displaying on desktop or failing to open.)
7: [choose_path, hint] Story Screen Interaction Hint: Add a descriptive hint on the story screen clarifying how desktop pets sit above open windows. (why: Multiple support requests reported post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling and moving pets.)
8: [finish, new_screen] New Companion Desktop Controls Overview Screen: Add a dedicated desktop controls screen before home intro illustrating drag, hide, and interaction gestures. (why: Support mailbox received multiple messages asking how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.)

scores.note: Grid layout redesigns are proven winners and adoption step suffers highest user drop-off.
New screens in the adoption step consistently perform well with +4.6% historical lift.
Carousel layout is not a winning layout type; adoption redesigns average -3.0% lift.
Interactive welcome screens align with past successful new screens.
Account preservation target hints are proven successful (+3.7%) and strongly backed by support tickets.
Sound cues explicitly showed no clear effect in previous tests.
Finish step redesigns have shown strong positive lift (+5.3%).
Target hints on choose_path historically yield consistent positive gains (+3.5%).
Adding dedicated new screens to the finish step consistently achieves +5.3% average lift.
